message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling:

| Title | Year Published | Genre |
|-------|----------------|-------|
| **Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone** (also known as *Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone* in the U.S.) | 1997 | Fantasy / Young Adult |
| **Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets** | 1998 | Fantasy / Young Adult |
| **Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban** | 1999 | Fantasy / Young Adult |
| **Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire** | 2000 | Fantasy / Young Adult |
| **Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix** | 2003 | Fantasy / Young Adult |
| **Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince** | 2005 | Fantasy / Young Adult |
| **Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows** | 2007 | Fantasy / Young Adult |
| **The Casual Vacancy** | 2012 | Contemporary Fiction |
| **The Cuckoo's Calling** (written under the pseudonym Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | Crime / Mystery |
| **The Silkworm** (written under the pseudonym Robert Galbraith) | 2014 | Crime / Mystery |
| **Career of Evil** (written under the pseudonym Robert Galbraith) | 2015 | Crime / Mystery |

These titles have achieved worldwide acclaim, sold millions of copies, and have been adapted into successful films and other media.
